description: Frost and hard control - freeze a target, then drop something heavy on it, with a raised caster working the whole time.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_necromancer__rime.txt and the 41 'rime' nodes in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/necromancer.json. CoA: 'Closest to a Frost Death Knight reskinned as a pure ranged caster with an Unholy DK pet layer bolted on ... The payoff loop is freeze-then-detonate.' The freeze half is the honest casualty of this port - the engine has no Frozen state, so Glacier Lord, Frigidness, Permafrost and Master Lich all become unconditional crit and Frost damage rather than conditional ones. What survives intact is the rest of the identity: a frost caster that keeps a raised minion up (Death and Ice, Blood and Ice, Champion of Kel'Thuzad) and funds its own payoff casts (Freeze Dry, Arch Lich, Raising the Kirin Tor). Stat priority is Spell Hit > Spell Power > Crit > Haste > Intellect > Spirit/MP5, which is why this tree carries two flat Frost spell power nodes where Death carries haste.

nodes.name: Runic Reservoir
nodes.description: Increases your Frost damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Frost damage by 5% and your maximum Runic Power by 15.' The pool half wanted life_force_max, which Character.get_resource_max genuinely reads but tools/audit_talents.py's hardcoded _NAMED_LIVE set does not list, so the validator calls it dead and it is left out rather than shipped as a key the tooling will keep flagging. Frost damage only.

nodes.name: Bone Legion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Lichfrost by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Lichfrost by 10% and its Runic Power generated by 25%.' The generation half is not talentable; Freeze Dry below is where extra Life Force comes from.

nodes.name: Hoarfrost Hands
nodes.description: Increases your hit rating by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Lichfrost's movement speed slow by 4 sec and your hit chance by 4%.' Slows do not exist on a monster, hit does, and Spell Hit is first in this spec's stat priority.

nodes.name: Curse of the Lich
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the range of your Rime spells by 6 yds and increases the Frost critical strike chance of you and your summons by 3%.' Range has no hook and crit is not per-school; the summon half is Death and Ice.

nodes.name: Piercing Icicles
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ice Barrage by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Ice Barrage by 20%.'

nodes.name: Frigid Death
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by 20%.' Glacial Impact is the spike the whole spec sets up.

nodes.name: Freeze Dry
nodes.description: Glacial Impact has a 20% chance per rank to restore 6 Life Force.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Glacial Impact now generates 20 Runic Power.' The payoff cast paying for itself, which is the whole point of CoA's dual-resource Rime loop - here it is one pool, so the refund is smaller and chance-based.

nodes.name: Frigid Power
nodes.description: Increases your Frost spell power by 10 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Lichfrost and Ice Barrage by 20%.' Per-ability spell power scaling is not a key; Frost spell power is, and both of those abilities are Frost.

nodes.name: Glacier Lord
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Glacial Impact is now guaranteed to critically strike against Frozen targets.' There is no Frozen state in the engine and no per-ability crit guarantee, so the node buys real crit chance instead - the same mechanic, paid for honestly.

nodes.name: Frigidness
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your Frost spells by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical damage by 50% against Frozen targets.' <school>_crit_damage_pct is a real runtime-built key, read in _crit_damage_bonus against the school the cast actually deals. Unconditional, since Frozen does not exist.

nodes.name: Arch Lich
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to restore 5 Life Force.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Frost spells now refund 3% of your maximum mana.' A Necromancer has no Mana pool at all (_recalculate_derived_stats only builds one for Mana-resource classes), so the refund is Life Force.

nodes.name: Deathly Chill
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ice Barrage by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the channel and cast time of Ice Barrage by -25%.' Cast time is not modelled; a cooldown is the closest thing to 'you get to do this more often'.

nodes.name: Necrotic Chains
nodes.description: Glacial Impact and Command: Bonefreeze freeze their target in place, no more than once every 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Every 3rd Command spell now freezes the target in place for 5 seconds.' Nothing counts casts, but a proc's internal cooldown does the same job: icd 3 means at most one freeze every three turns. One rank, because a 100% chance has nothing left to scale.

nodes.name: Permafrost
nodes.description: Increases your Frost damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Gives your spells a 15% chance to grant you the Permafrost, which treats your next 2 spells cast as the target were Frozen.' Frozen is not a state the engine has, so there is nothing to pretend about - the node is the Frost damage the pretence was worth.

nodes.name: Icecrown
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Frost damage dealt now increases your allies' critical strike chance against the enemy by 1% for 10 seconds, stacking 3 times.' A talent is read off its own character only, so the ally half is impossible here - the Chilling Presence ability carries the party crit aura instead and this is the self share.

nodes.name: Death and Ice
nodes.description: Increases your minion's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While a Skeletal Mage is active the critical strike chance of your Undead minions is now increased by 10%.' pet_damage is one of exactly three owner talent keys a Pet reads (see entities/pet.py) and it is a FRACTION - 0.04 is +4%. Pet crit is not one of them.

nodes.name: Frozen Bodies
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to increase your damage dealt by 6% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you kill an enemy ... or critically strike with Frost damage you now gain a stack of Frozen Bodies. Increases the damage of your next Glacial Impact by 3%, stacking 10 times.' Banked stacks that only one ability can spend have no hook, so it is a short damage window off the same trigger.

nodes.name: Champion of Kel'Thuzad
nodes.description: Raise: Skeletal Mage costs 10 less Life Force.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Skeletal Mages now only cost 1 Life Force.' In CoA Life Force is a minion budget; here it is the class's spending pool, so 'costs less of it' is the same sentence. ability_<id>_cost is a flat reduction, applied before any percentage one.

nodes.name: Blood and Ice
nodes.description: Increases your minion's health by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each Skeletal Warrior or Skeletal Rogue now increases the damage of your Ice Barrage by 8%.' Nothing counts active minions, and only one pet can be active at a time, so the node keeps the one half that works: the minion lasts longer. pet_health is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Harrowing Winds
nodes.description: Increases the damage your area effects deal by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Glacial Impact now deals an additional 50% of the damage dealt as Frost damage to enemies within 6 yds of the primary target.' Glacial Impact is single-target here, so the splash lands on the spec's real AoE - Animate: Frost Wyrm and Command: Bonefreeze's follow-ups.

nodes.name: Master Lich
nodes.description: Increases your Frost damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Soulfreeze now increases the enemy's Frost damage taken by you by 5% per tick for 8 sec, stacking 3 times.' An enemy's frost_damage_taken_pct is read off status effects on a Character but not on a Monster, so the increase sits on the caster's own Frost damage.

nodes.name: Raising the Kirin Tor
nodes.description: Your damage spells have a 20% chance per rank to restore 8 Life Force.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Command spells now have a 40% chance to refund a portion of their Runic Power cost.' Nothing groups abilities into CoA's Command school, so it fires off any damage cast at half the chance.

nodes.name: Army of the North
nodes.description: What you have raised fights like it remembers being alive, and the cold comes off you harder.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Chant a powerful ritual that brings forth 1 Rotting Frost Giant near you ... For the duration, your Undead minions are guaranteed to critically strike.' There is no frost-giant pet template and none may be added, and a talent cannot summon, so the capstone is what the Giant and the guaranteed crits were worth: a permanently stronger minion and more Frost damage.
